   Unsupervised learning analyses a stream of data, finds patterns, and makes predictions without any other guidance.(

   Transfer learning is when the knowledge gained from one problem is applied to a new problem.(

📌

Ghost Core is a personal AI computer designed to keep your AI, data, and context on your own hardware.  
  
What makes it different: Core runs its models locally and continuously builds context from your apps, files, screen history, and connected devices, allowing its AI to act proactively rather than waiting for every prompt.  
  
Key features:  
• Run AI models entirely on-device  
• Connect to apps, files, and devices  
• Build continuous context over time  
• Work proactively without waiting for a prompt  
• Connect to wearables and smart-home devices  
• Use local models including Qwen, Gemma, and Muse-Glimmer  
• 64 GB DDR5 memory and 1 TB NVMe storage  
• NVIDIA RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell GPU with 24 GB GDDR7 ECC memory  
  
Who it's for: People who want a personal AI system with local intelligence, continuous context, and control over their data.  
  
Ghost Core is available to order for $3,499.
